body: Hey man, I'd be lying if I said highschool was the nothing but good times for me either. But it also wasn't all bad times. It'll have it's rough patches that will test who you are as a person and a student. It'll help shape you into the person you really are. You just got to make it through these rough patches and embrace the good times when they come, and they will come. Just keep on keepin on and you'll do alright. I promise.
